• **Security Alert**: 2026 FIFA World Cup Faces Surge in Cyber Threats

• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 47 articles published in the last 24 hours
